title: Notes App (EJS)
about: NotesApp is a CRUD-based web application designed to help users manage notes using a simple and intuitive interface.
Built with Node.js, Express.js, EJS, and MongoDB (via Mongoose), the project focuses on server-side rendering and database integration.
The application uses structured Express routes and Mongoose models to define and manage note data efficiently.
This project serves as a practical learning tool for understanding full-stack development concepts such as templating, routing, and persistent data storage.
description: Server-rendered notes application supporting CRUD operations using Express, EJS, and MongoDB.

title: Emart
about: E-Mart is a role-based e-commerce web application that allows users to browse products while granting administrative control exclusively to the admin.
Built using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and EJS templates, the project demonstrates full-stack development with server-side rendering.
User authentication, session management, and access control are implemented using express-session, cookies, and flash messages.
The project is designed as a scalable foundation for advanced e-commerce features such as shopping carts, payment integration, and order management.
description: E-Mart is a full-stack e-commerce web application built with Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and EJS, featuring user authentication, role-based access control, and admin-managed product handling. It uses session-based authentication with flash messages and provides a scalable foundation for advanced e-commerce features.

title: KeepNotes
description: Simple React note-saving application with Redux and local storage.

title: Sarthi Hospital
about: A full-fledged hospital management frontend built using React, offering appointment scheduling, doctor management, and patient records UI.
description: A full-fledged hospital management frontend built using React, offering appointment scheduling, doctor management, and patient records UI.
